words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) opens the reward clause as certified assertion before the secure station is even named. After the exposed punishment and doubting scene of 44:49-44:50, the repeated assertion turns into a hinge of reversal: what was certified against the doubter is now certified for the guarded. The verbless nominal architecture makes the reward sound like a settled state rather than an event sequence, and the doubled sound at the opening tightens that certainty before the clause unfolds.

The definite Form VIII active participle makes them a recognized class formed by practiced guardedness, not merely people who happen to be innocent or passively protected. Its doubled middle also makes the class-name sound tightened before the line opens into the secure locative phrase. Because the word leaves the avoided object unstated, the protective stance is broad: a whole posture of wary self-guarding is answered by an objectively safe environment. That answer is local in the phrase itself, where guardedness moves toward {{ar:مَقَامٍ}} ({{tr:maqāmin}}) and is completed by {{ar:أَمِينٍ}} ({{tr:amīnin}}). The word also carries wider pressure: the guided audience named in 2:2 reaches secure placement here, and the same root later becomes completed protection in 44:56. Across the boundary from the maintained doubting of 44:50, the discourse changes from direct accusation to third-person reward proclamation.

words.prose: {{ar:مَقَامٍ}} ({{tr:maqāmin}}) is governed by {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), so the station is the domain containing the guarded rather than an object handed to them. Its indefiniteness keeps the place from becoming a named site; the following adjective must define its quality. The root field of standing and establishment is locally narrowed to a station or standing-place, but that narrowing still matters: the reward feels like ordered stability, rank, and maintained standing, not scenery. That station-form is salient within a root otherwise spread across people-scenes, standing, establishing, and rising. The noun form turns standing into a stable predicate center, and the accepted vocalic variant {{ar:مُقَامٍ}} ({{tr:muqāmin}}) adds residence pressure without changing the governed syntax. The root-pairing with guardedness and security makes the station the place where ethical protection becomes established safety. Intertextually, 14:14 turns feared standing into the secure station here, while 44:26's abandoned noble station is answered by a secure station for the guarded. The matched cadence with {{ar:أَمِينٍ}} ({{tr:amīnin}}) lets that station-security bond be heard as one secured phrase as well as parsed.

words.prose: {{ar:أَمِينٍۢ}} ({{tr:amīnin}}) completes the predicate by qualifying {{ar:مَقَامٍ}} ({{tr:maqāmin}}), not the people directly. Its matching genitive, indefinite, masculine singular form places safety in the environment: the station itself is secure and trustworthy. The adjective does more than say the place is intact; it adds reliability against fear and betrayal, turning location into a fear-free order. It also completes the ayah's moral arc: {{ar:ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ}} ({{tr:al-muttaqīna}}) names guarded conduct, and {{ar:أَمِينٍۢ}} ({{tr:amīnin}}) names the safety that answers it. The same adjective narrows public security from the city in 95:3 into this inhabited station, and within the surah it shifts trustworthiness from the envoy of 44:18 to the environment of 44:51. Its nasal cadence echoes {{ar:مَقَامٍ}} ({{tr:maqāmin}}), making the adjective's attachment to the head audible as well as grammatical. As the final word, with final nunation and recitational marking at the pause, it makes security the semantic and auditory landing, answering the restless doubt of 44:50 and preparing the security-belief field that returns in 44:55.

baseline_models.mechanism: Self-protective caution, an inhabitable station, and settled trust form a three-part mechanism: guarded persons occupy a residence where danger no longer has access and the heart can settle.

activation_trace.role: Placing the self in protective caution supplies the occupants' practiced guardedness.
A standing-place or residence turns guardedness into a continuing inhabitable condition.
Settled security and trust qualify the residence as one in which fear can cease.

changed_reading.before: The pious are located in a safe place.
changed_reading.after: People formed by protective caution inhabit a settled residence whose reliability lets vigilance come to rest.

baseline_models.mechanism: The station is not passive coordinates. The standing-over branch supplies maintenance and guardianship, while the trust branch lets the place act conceptually like a custodian that does not betray what it holds.

activation_trace.role: Care, guardianship, and preservation make the station an actively maintained condition.
Trustworthiness allows an inanimate station to be heard as a reliable keeper of its occupants.
A barrier warding off harm supplies the custodial station's protective function.

changed_reading.before: Safety is the passive absence of danger at a location.
changed_reading.after: The station continuously keeps its occupants, behaving like a trustworthy custody that will not expose or surrender them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مقام as standing and أمين as settled security
baseline_models.mechanism: The resurrection branch of standing activates a scene of rising and remaining upright, while protective caution and trust distinguish one secure standing within that scene.

activation_trace.role: Protective moral caution marks the people whose standing is being differentiated.
Rising at resurrection turns مقام from a generic dwelling into a possible eschatological standing.
Settled security distinguishes this standing from exposure or fear.

changed_reading.before: The verse promises a protected long-term home.
changed_reading.after: The verse may also mark a secure standing after universal rising, before it names the surrounding pleasures.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context first opposes certainty to being inside doubt and then places wavering denial immediately before the focus. The secure station can therefore be an epistemic settlement as well as a physical refuge.

activation_trace.role: Fixed knowledge with doubt removed supplies the positive pole of cognitive stability.
Interpenetrating possibilities that prevent certainty supply an unstable condition explicitly inhabited with في.
Doubt and vacillation name the instability immediately preceding the focus assertion.
The station spatializes the alternative condition as somewhere stable to remain.
Settled trust converts the opposite of doubt into the station's defining quality.

structural_cues: The repeated construction with في places one group inside doubt at 44:9 and the focus group inside a secure station.
The vacillation cue at 44:50 directly precedes the emphatic focus assertion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies certainty, inhabited doubt, final vacillation, and settled trust; I supply the arrow from cognitive instability to spatial settlement. A live alternative is that the epistemic and locative contrasts remain parallel rather than causally linked.

changed_reading.before: The station protects bodies from external danger.
changed_reading.after: The station also figures arrival at settled trust after a discourse repeatedly destabilized by doubt and denial.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same trust root first qualifies a messenger, then appears as the refused act of believing him, and finally qualifies a station. Reliability migrates from a social bearer of testimony into an environment.

activation_trace.role: Trustworthiness embodied by the messenger supplies the interpersonal form of security.
Refused trusting assent makes reception or rejection of reliable testimony an active hinge.
Residence gives the earlier interpersonal trust a spatial endpoint.
The trusted quality now belongs to the station itself, making it non-betraying.

structural_cues: أمين qualifies a messenger at 44:18 and a station at 44:51.
The intervening refusal to believe at 44:21 keeps the shared root socially active.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated trust root on person, response, and place; I infer a trajectory in which accepted reliability becomes inhabitable. The alternative is three independent uses of one root with no transfer among them.

changed_reading.before: أمين means only that the destination is free from attack.
changed_reading.after: The destination is also trustworthy: reliable testimony has become a habitat that will not betray those who dwell in it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night travel under pursuit passes through an opened, stilled sea; the pursuers drown and the pursued are extracted. Against that kinetic sequence, مقام becomes terminal stability and أمين means that pursuit cannot restart.

activation_trace.role: Night journey supplies compelled movement away from danger.
Catching up and pursuit make continued motion necessary rather than elective.
A wide open gap supplies the traversable passage between danger and rest.
Drowning terminates the pursuing force and closes the route behind the escapees.
Rescue by separation supplies the transition from threatened contact to protected distance.
A station or residence is the stable terminus opposed to forced travel.
Settled security means the terminus is no longer vulnerable to renewed pursuit.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from night departure to pursuit, passage, drowning, and rescue before the focus supplies residence.
The focus's plural occupants share one singular station, fitting a collective arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies travel, pursuit, a passage, drowning, rescue, and later residence; I infer that the residence is read through the completed escape. The alternative is that the earlier rescue is only a historical analogy and does not define the later station.

changed_reading.before: The secure station is a static privilege possessed from the outset.
changed_reading.after: It is an arrival after compelled movement, secure precisely because the pursuing danger can no longer follow.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier people leave gardens, springs, and a noble station that then passes to others. The focus repeats مقام but replaces noble status with trust and security, distinguishing impressive property from reliable tenure.

activation_trace.role: Abandonment shows that splendid surroundings can be relinquished under compulsion.
The earlier station or residence creates the exact locative comparator for the focus.
Honor and admired generosity make the abandoned station prestigious but not durable.
Transfer from a predecessor to an heir proves that occupancy can change while the place remains.
The repeated station invites comparison of two modes of residence.
Reliability and settled security correct the earlier station's failure to keep its occupants.

structural_cues: The earlier sequence binds gardens and springs to مقام كريم, then narrates abandonment and succession.
The focus reuses مقام but changes its qualifier to أمين before gardens and springs reappear.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two stations, the first noble yet abandoned and inherited, the second secure; I infer that the changed adjective answers the first station's failure. The alternative is simple contrast between condemned and rewarded owners without a critique of prestige itself.

changed_reading.before: The focus promises a station that is simply more splendid or honorable.
changed_reading.after: Its decisive superiority is non-betraying tenure: nobility can survive while occupants are expelled, but this station securely keeps them.

context_deltas.mechanism: A fixed day gathers everyone for decisive separation, where ordinary patronage cannot secure anyone and mercy is the stated exception. This strengthens the baseline resurrection branch into an adjudicated standing rather than a private refuge obtained through social leverage.

activation_trace.role: Judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the allocation event behind distinct outcomes.
An appointed term makes the separation a fixed encounter rather than an indefinite threat.
A day or summons gathering people supplies the universal assembly in which the station matters.
Affiliative support and patronage are explicitly unable to manufacture security at that encounter.
Merciful tenderness supplies the stated exception to failed horizontal rescue.
Resurrection and rising identify the focus station as a secure standing within the gathered event.
Settled security marks the adjudicated outcome as free from fear.

structural_cues: 44:40-42 forms one sequence: fixed gathering, failed patronage, then mercy as exception.
The focus follows the punishment tableau as the contrasting collective outcome.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering, judicial separation, failed allies, mercy, and a resurrection branch on the focus root; I infer that the station is the favorable standing allocated by that process. The alternative is a later residence only, with no emphasis on standing at judgment.

changed_reading.before: The secure station is a private shelter associated with piety.
changed_reading.after: It is a publicly differentiated standing after universal assembly, secured by mercy rather than patronage or rank.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, a body is dragged into the middle of blazing fire and liquid is poured down from above. The secure station reverses each spatial relation: coercive transport becomes residence, exposed center becomes protected place, and breached vertical boundary becomes warded integrity.

activation_trace.role: Violent dragging and coercion supply forced emplacement as the opposite of settled residence.
The middle or central place locates punishment in a maximally exposed interior.
Intensely blazing fire makes the imposed location itself the source of harm.
Pouring supplies a penetrating flow that defeats any bodily shelter.
The upper direction makes exposure vertical as well as surrounding.
A barrier warding harm supplies intact boundaries in the contrasting scene.
Residence reverses the coercive dragging that placed the punished body.
Settled safety names the resulting freedom from spatial assault.

structural_cues: 44:47-48 builds a directional geometry of toward, middle, and above immediately before 44:51.
The command-driven passive body contrasts with the focus group's stable locative construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies violent motion, central emplacement, overhead pouring, fire, barrier, and residence; I infer a point-for-point spatial reversal. The alternative is a broad reward-punishment contrast without this detailed geometry.

changed_reading.before: The station is pleasant because it is away from punishment.
changed_reading.after: Its security is bodily and spatial sovereignty: no dragging, no hostile center, and no direction from which its boundary can be breached.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus barrier is followed by tree-hidden gardens, a sibling shield branch on the same garden root, and clothing. Security becomes a set of nested ecological, architectural, and bodily coverings rather than an abstract label.

activation_trace.role: A protective barrier supplies the organizing image of layered enclosure.
Residence gives the layers a shared inhabitable center.
A garden hidden by its trees supplies ecological enclosure around the station.
The sibling protective-shield branch makes the garden's concealment function as material shelter in the model.
Covering by clothing brings protection to the occupants' bodily surface.
The occupants' explicit settled security confirms that the layers culminate in felt safety.

structural_cues: The post-focus sequence expands from station to gardens to garments to explicitly secure occupants.
The garden root itself holds both concealment and shield branches.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a warding barrier, concealed gardens, a sibling shield image, clothing, and felt security; I assemble these as nested layers. The live alternative is that gardens and garments are independent pleasures rather than parts of one protective material system.

changed_reading.before: Security is an abstract property of one location.
changed_reading.after: Security is materially nested: guarded persons within a residence, within tree-cover, with covering brought to the body itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Protective caution does not culminate in isolation. The occupants face one another, call freely for what they desire, and are explicitly secure; the function of protection is to release defensive orientation into social openness.

activation_trace.role: Self-protective caution supplies the guarded posture that the later scene can relax.
Face-to-face orientation turns safety toward mutual presence rather than defensive withdrawal.
Calling and drawing by speech supply unimpeded social agency within the station.
Settled security names the condition that permits facing and calling without vigilance.

structural_cues: The participial sequence moves from protected occupants to mutual facing and active calling.
The later plural adjective transfers the focus station's security directly to its inhabitants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-guarding, face-to-face posture, calling, and felt security; I infer that safety enables openness rather than merely coexisting with it. The alternative is a visual banquet arrangement with no claim about transformed vigilance.

changed_reading.before: Protection works by withdrawal behind a barrier.
changed_reading.after: Protection succeeds when guarded people no longer need to turn away: they can face one another and act openly without exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus names people through self-protective caution, but the later recurrence of the same root makes them the recipients of warding. Mercy is the exception to failed rescue and the outcome is called a gift, so practiced caution culminates in protection supplied from beyond the self.

activation_trace.role: Merciful tenderness supplies the exceptional agency that can rescue when patrons cannot.
Placing the self in protective caution supplies the occupants' prior orientation and naming.
Settled security is the state produced when protection no longer depends on the self alone.
Warding harm off now acts upon the occupants, reversing them from guarding agents into protected objects.
Gift and benefaction prevent the resulting security from being reduced to self-produced technique.

structural_cues: The same protection root appears in the focus's people-name and later in a verb acting on them.
Mercy precedes the focus and gift follows the explicit warding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies self-protective naming, external warding, mercy, and gift; I infer a completion relation in which practiced caution is met by protection from another agent. The alternative is a simple virtue-result sequence without reciprocal root-play.

changed_reading.before: The cautious secure themselves and thereby earn a safe station.
changed_reading.after: Their caution names a receptive posture, but the station is secure because mercy actively wards harm from them as a gift.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following verse denies any further experiential encounter with death and explicitly wards off blazing punishment. Because the station branch includes residence and its time, أمين expands from local safety into irreversible tenure across the mortality boundary.

activation_trace.role: Station, residence, and duration make the focus capable of bearing temporal as well as spatial security.
Settled security characterizes the tenure as reliable rather than provisional.
Experiencing or testing a thing makes the negation concern any renewed encounter, not mere abstract knowledge.
A death-state and a single death delimit mortality to the completed first event.
Explicit warding from harm seals the station against the punished alternative.

structural_cues: The locative فيها repeats after the focus while death is excluded from that domain.
The exception confines death to the first occurrence rather than leaving future tenure open.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies residence or duration, settled security, no renewed experience of death, and explicit warding; I infer that permanence is internal to the adjective's force here. The alternative is that أمين remains spatial and immortality is a separate subsequent benefit.

changed_reading.before: The occupants are safe for as long as they happen to remain there.
changed_reading.after: The station's tenure is itself secure: no second death or punitive breach can terminate residence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because metal assay and molten material are branch-distant from the syntax of مقام أمين. It remains valid as an analogy because the focus trust branch can mean reliable, while the context explicitly supplies testing that reveals condition and molten matter. Downstream prose should say the station is read as if assay-proven, not claim that أمين lexically means assayed.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: أمين as the reliability of مقام

activation_trace.role: Testing metal or a person supplies an assay that exposes whether something holds true.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Protective caution culminates in a station that itself provides security.** `و ق ي B002` supplies placing oneself in protective caution, `ق و م B006` station/residence, and `ء م ن B001` settled security. The agentive `متقين` is followed by locative `في` and a secure place; I infer a transition from practiced guarding to an environment where guarding is no longer precarious. The ayah reads the station as the spatial fruit of caution.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 44:52-55 unfolds the station into gardens, springs, garments, reciprocal facing, pairing, fruit, and security. The later detail confirms that `مقام أمين` is a complete social-material environment, not a bare safe coordinate.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Inner guarding becomes external protection.** `و ق ي` `B002` is placing oneself in protective caution; within five ayat, the same root reappears as `وَقَىٰهُمْ` in `44:56`, where `B001` is warding harm with a barrier. The participial disposition here and the later protective act form an inside/outside sequence. The packet supplies root recurrence; I infer **sustained protective caution -> reception of an effective external guard**. `ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ` reads as a posture fitted to the protection later supplied, not self-salvation.

2. **The secure station is the spatial counterform to the blaze’s center.** `ق و م` `B006` is station or residence and `B009` a sustaining support; `ء م ن` `B001` is settled security and a safe place. Four ayat earlier the other figure is dragged to the middle of the blaze (`44:47`). Both are placements, but one supports stable residence and the other enforces exposure. The packet supplies the opposed locations; I infer **adjudicated placement -> environment fitted to each route**. `مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍ` reads as structural security, not only a pleasant mood.

3. **The station presupposes renewed standing.** `ق و م` `B013` is resurrection and rising of the Hour, and `44:56` says the secure occupants do not taste death beyond the first death. The branch assigns `مَقَام` a post-death standing role rather than an ordinary temporary stop. The packet supplies station and the later first-death boundary; I infer **renewed rising -> stable appointed residence**. The ayah makes continued standing spatially concrete.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: `44:57` gathers the station’s features under “great triumph,” confirming security as part of an integrated outcome rather than an isolated shelter. Final reciprocal watching (`44:59`) adds a subtle correction: secure standing is compatible with sustained attentiveness and does not collapse into inert ease.

Bu nedenle dal korunabilir, fakat geçici hayvanın kendini koruması çerçevesi bütün malzemeyi taşıyacak biçimde aksama ve ona bağlı kullanımlar olarak yeniden kurulmalıdır.

facets.statement: Tek sözcüklü temel anlam, hayvanın yürüyüşündeki hafif topallamadır.
At, topalladığı veya toynağındaki ağrı yüzünden yürümekten çekindiği ve sert zeminde ayağını sakındığı için bu nitelemeyi alır.
Hayvana yönelik emir kalıbı, onun aksayışını gözeterek yürümeyi sürdürme ve kendini zorlamama anlamı taşır.
Eyer için kullanıldığında hayvanın sırtını yaralamayan veya berelenmesine yol açmayan eyer anlatılır.
Sert ve engebeli zeminle kurulan olumsuz emir, arazinin güçlüğünden yakınmama anlamına gelir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin ayakta kalmasını sağlayan dayanak, düzen, temel unsur ve geçim aracı çekirdeğini destekler. Bedenin bütünlüğü, işin düzeni ve dünya ile sonrası için geçim bu işlevsel dayanma ilişkisinin uygulamalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bir şeyin sürmesini sağlayan dayanak ve geçim temelidir; gözetim eylemi veya beden boyu değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın dayanak ve sürdürme aracı tanımlanır; başka dallardaki yönetim, boy ve fiyat anlamları eklenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir işin, düzenin, bedenin veya yaşamın ayakta kalmasını sağlayan temel dayanak, düzenleyici unsur ya da yeterli geçim aracıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin varlığını ve düzenini sürdürmesini sağlayan temel dayanak veya düzenleyici unsur bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir işin veya varlığın ayakta kalmasını sağlayan dayanak, düzen ve temel unsurda birleşir; yaşamı ve bedeni sürdüren geçim de aynı işlev üzerinden açıklanır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir malın bedelini belirleme işlemini, bu işlemle ortaya çıkan değeri ve tarafların bu değer üzerinde hesaplaşmasını destekler. Bir şeyin yerini tutma düşüncesi kökensel açıklamadır; dalın güncel çekirdeği değer biçme ve belirlenen bedeldir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal ekonomik değer biçme ve bedelle sınırlıdır; genel olarak başkasının yerini alma veya temel dayanak değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Belirlenen bedel ile mala değer biçme yapıları ayrılır; kapsam genel değiş tokuşa veya yerini tutmaya genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir malın parasal değerini belirlemek ve bu değerlendirme sonucunda ortaya çıkan bedeldir; tarafların değer üzerinde karşılıklı hesaplaşması da bu alana bağlıdır.

facets.statement: Bir mala değer biçilir ve bu işlem sonucunda onun bedeli belirlenir.
Tarafların bir malın değeri üzerinde karşılıklı hesaplaşması, değer biçme çekirdeğine bağlı kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, malın bedelini değerlendirme yoluyla belirleme ve belirlenen değeri adlandırma çekirdeğinde birleşir; karşılıklı değer hesabı da buna bağlanır.

facets.statement: Bir araç veya varlığın dik duran, taşıyan ya da elle tutulan işlevsel parçası adlandırılır.
Kuyu başında insan biçiminde yapılmış bir düzenek açıklaması aktarılmış, fakat başka bir kaynakça yorumunda yanlış sayılmıştır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadeleri bu dali yalniz korkunun kalkmasi olarak degil, kalbin yatismasi, guven verme, guvenilirlik, emanet edilen sey, guvenli yer ve dayanilir nitelik alanlariyla birlikte verir. Bu nedenle dalin cercevesi, guvenlik ve guvenilirlik ekseninde hem yalın hem de yapimli ve baglamli kullanislari ayirt ederek korunabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalin guven ve korkusuzluk anlamlari ile belirli yapimli ya da soz obegi kullanislari birlikte vardir; tanim bunlari tek bir dar kaliba indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Korkunun kalkmasiyla kalbin yatismasi, birine guven verilmesi veya bir kimsenin ya da seyin guvenilir kabul edilmesidir. Bu alan guvenli yer, emanet edilen sey, kendisine guvenilen kisi ve dayanilir binek gibi bagimli uygulamalari da kapsar.

facets.statement: Temel cekirdek korkuya karsi guven, ic yatiskinligi ve tehlikeden emin olma halidir.
Guven verme, birini kendi koruma ve teminat alani icine alma olarak kullanilir.
Guvenilirlik, ihanete karsi sadakat, emanet edilen sey ve kendisine guvenilen kisi anlamlarini dogurur.
Guvenin bulundugu yer, bir kimsenin emniyet icinde oldugu mesken veya siginak olarak adlandirilir.
Dayanikli ve aksamasindan korkulmayan deve kullanimi, guvenilirlik niteligini canli bir ornege uygular.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه آمين في الدعاء بالمد والقصر، والتأمين بمعنى قول آمين، وتفسيرها باستجب أو اللهم افعل أو كذلك فليكن، مع ذكر قول من جعلها اسما من أسماء الله.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الأمن ضد الخوف، ولا الأمانة، ولا الإيمان بمعنى التصديق، ولا أمن التي هي أم من وليست من الباب.
branches.source_phrase_ar: قولنا في الدعاء آمين وتفسيره اللهم افعل (maqayis)؛ التأمين من قولك آمين (ayn)؛ آمين في الدعاء يمد ويقصر ومعناه كذلك فليكن (sihah)؛ آمين يقال بالمد والقصر وهو اسم للفعل ومعناه استجب وأمن فلان إذا قال آمين (mufradat)

root_profile.summary: Bu kok ailesi guven ve korkusuzluk, dogru sayip kabul etme ve duada kabul istegi sozu olmak uzere birbirine tarihsel olarak yakin ama islevce ayrilan uc ana alanda duzenlenir. Ortak bag kalbin yatismasi ve kabul duygusudur, fakat her dalin siniri guvenlik, tasdik ve dua formulu olarak ayri tutulmalidir.

full_context_packet.note: surah-scope fallback: the default commentary workflow does not consume per-ayah focus packets, so the source packet is scoped by this builder to roots this ayah can justify and carries no staged reveal order

scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

v12_reader_responses.note: Per-ayah focus-run reader responses are retired from the default commentary workflow. Use regular reader walks, plus/minus-5 reader walks, and cross-run publication findings for corpus-wide reader-derived evidence.

v12_cross_run_publication.note: Compact final cross-run findings for this ayah, reconciled upstream from regular and plus/minus-5 reader runs; use as a coverage/priority check, not as replacement prose.
